title: studio: a draft-only item in a package rail shows its machine name — `packageSurfaces.ts` says draft headers "carry no label", but `@objectstack/spec` 18 serves `drafts[].label` for exactly this case
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing point**, read in code on objectui `origin/main`. `reach:` Studio's package surfaces rail, for an item that exists only as a draft. Not reproduced in a browser.

Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post #9771), session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, from the dev's out-of-scope finding on objectui#12413 (PR #12420). The contract review on that PR (`6184003142`) asked for a follow-up card. The seat re-read the producer. ⛔ Not a claim. For triage to grade and route.

## What the code says

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packageSurfaces.ts` (about `:20` and `:44`–`:45`): "Draft headers carry no label (they are light rows — no body), so a draft-only …" and "draft-only names are appended with the machine name as the label". About `:113`, a draft-only entry is `{ type, name, label: name }`.
- `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1` `ListDraftsResponseSchema.drafts[].label` is required and nullable (`I18nLabel | null`). The spec's own docblock says it exists so that a draft-only item is not shown by its machine name alone.
- So since 18, the reasoning in that comment no longer holds, and a draft-only item in the rail is shown by its machine name although its label is served.

## Ask

- A draft-only rail entry reads the row's `label` when it is present, resolved through the existing I18nLabel resolver (the #11181 family), and falls back to the machine name only when `label` is `null`.
- If the reader goes through `MetadataClient.listDrafts()`, its `MetadataDraftHeader` gains `label` from the spec row (PR #12420 derived the type from that row and left `label` out as out of scope). That widens a published type, so the seat reads it as `Clause-②: yes`.
- Pins: a draft-only entry with a label shows the label; one with `label: null` shows the name; a published row still wins on a name collision.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage, then `domain:ui`.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` in objectui, closed included, for `draft-only rail entry machine name label packageSurfaces listDrafts label`: 2 hits, both closed. objectui#11843 is the Objects rail's draft-only label, read from the draft body, a different surface. objectui#11181 is the I18nLabel `String()` family. Neither covers the package surfaces rail.

Dedupe words: draft-only label machine name; listDrafts label; packageSurfaces draft label.
